# LumeAir website

This repository is the source of the LumeAir website. **Read it at
[kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site](https://kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site/).**

The pages here are Markdown files that GitHub Pages turns into the website.
Opened on GitHub they show as plain source, where some things don't work:
the **Install firmware** button on the build guide only works on the
website.

| Page | On the website |
|---|---|
| Home | [kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site](https://kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site/) |
| Support | [Support](https://kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site/Support) |
| Privacy policy | [Privacy](https://kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site/Privacy) |
| Build your own LumeAir | [Build](https://kylebcine.github.io/lumeair-site/Build) |

The `firmware` folder holds the sensor firmware releases that the LumeAir
Home app and the build guide install from.

Related: [LumeAir hardware](https://github.com/KyleBcine/lumeair-hardware) ·
[LumeAir for Home Assistant](https://github.com/KyleBcine/lumeair-homeassistant)
